messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] order of dumping parameters of arrays
parts:
I'll look into it.

What should be happening is that both get
dumped out in column-major order (and its
generalization). So if you have an
array x[2,2,2], the order should be

x[1,1,1], x[1,1,2], x[1,2,1], x[1,2,2], ...

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] order of dumping parameters of arrays
parts:
I patched Stan so that the output order for derived
params matches those for params. The order I gave
last time was right, but it's row-major, not column
major. So if we have a[2,2,2] the output order is

a[1,1,1], a[1,1,2], a[1,2,1], a[1,2,2],
a[2,1,1], a[2,1,2], a[2,2,1], a[2,2,2].

- Bob
